intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Teriyaki-chicken and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Teriyaki chicken may contain gluten due to the use of soy sauce and other ingredients that can have wheat. It's important to verify the specific ingredients used in the preparation.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Teriyaki-chicken can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: Can BiteRight confirm if Teriyaki-chicken is gluten free?

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
faq.answer: Ask about shared equipment, sauces, marinades, and whether the kitchen has a dedicated gluten-free prep area.
